source.title: Nebraska Secretary of State 2026 Official Election Calendar

milestones.label: SEPTEMBER 28
milestones.description: Early voting ballots start going out by mail.

milestones.label: OCTOBER 5
milestones.description: Early in-person voting begins at the County Election Office.

milestones.label: OCTOBER 16
milestones.description: Register online before midnight. Mailed registrations must be postmarked by Oct. 16.

milestones.label: OCTOBER 23
milestones.description: Register in person at the county office by 6 PM. Mail-ballot requests must arrive by 6 PM.

milestones.label: NOVEMBER 3
milestones.description:
Election Day
Polls: 8 AM to 8 PM.
Early ballots must be received by 8 PM.
